blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer efficient inference at massive parameter scales, gain increasing prevalence in the community, a critical gap arising from the lack of systematic recipes for applying PEFT to MoE models. To narrow this gap, we conduct a large-scale systematic study that investigates a set of essential design recipes, including which modules should be adapted, which granularity should be used to adapt MoE modules, which PEFT method to use, and to what extent should the load-balancing objective be used, across three MoE backbones on downstream tasks and general knowledge tasks. Our experiments yield several key insights. First, adapting MoE experts alone achieves the highest downstream performance with competitive general capability retention under a comparable parameter budget. Second, native expert-weight updates offer a better downstream--retention trade-off than adapters that bypass experts or entire MoE modules. Third, LoRA and DoRA together define the strongest operating region for high downstream accuracy among the evaluated PEFT methods. Fourth, no nonzero load-balancing coefficient Pareto-dominates the zero baseline. We finally evaluate a weight-level redesign of MoE$^2$-LoRA on Qwen3. Moving its module-level bypass pool into native expert weights improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters and a 3.2-point average downstream cost.
blocks.zh: 参数效率微调(PEFT)方法对于在受资源限制的情况下调整大型模型至关重要。 然而,由于专家混合结构在大规模参数尺度上提供了有效的推论,因此在社区中日益普遍,由于缺乏将PEFT应用于教育部模型的系统方法,造成一个重大差距。 为了缩小这一差距,我们进行了大规模的系统研究,在三个关于下游任务的教育部骨干和一般知识任务的骨干上,调查一套基本设计方法,包括应调整哪些模块、应采用何种颗粒性来调整教育部模块、应采用何种PEFT方法以及应在何种程度上使用负载平衡目标。 我们的实验产生了若干关键见解。 首先,仅根据可比参数预算,使教育部专家具有竞争力的一般能力保留,就能取得最高的下游业绩。 其次,本地专家加权更新比绕过专家或整个教育部模块的适配器更能提供下游-保留取舍。 第三,LORA和DORA共同界定了经评价的PEFT方法中最强的操作区域,以达到高下游精度. 第四,没有非零负载平衡系数Pareto占据了零基线. 我们最终评估了Wen3上2美元-LORA的重量级重新设计。 将其模块级绕行池移入本土专家权重,使所有四个上游端点都提高了2.4至17.9分,可训练参数减少17%,下游平均成本为3.2分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Mixture-of-experts architectures ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Lepikhin et al., 2021 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Du et al., 2022 ) enable extensive scaling of model parameters while activating only a small fraction of parameters per input unit. This sparse activation paradigm offers an outstanding trade-off between performance and computation, and has consequently been adopted by frontier models such as GLM-5.2 ( GLM-5 Team, 2026 ) and Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) . Despite the increasing prevalence of MoE architectures, most existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Houlsby et al., 2019 ; Li and Liang, 2021 ) and recipes were originally designed for dense models, and the community still lacks a systematic guideline for applying PEFT methods to MoE structures. Given that MoE models typically comprise a massive number of parameters, it is essential to adopt a scientifically grounded guideline for applying PEFT to such models to achieve efficient adaptation. This gap therefore raises a pressing question: How can we adapt MoE models to achieve the best performance-efficiency balance with the least forgetting?
blocks.zh: 专家结构 (Shazeer等人,2017年;Lepikhin等人,2021年;Fedus等人,2022年;Du等人,2022年) 能够对模型参数进行广泛的缩放,同时每个输入单元只激活一小部分参数. 这种稀少的激活范式在性能和计算之间提供了杰出的权衡,因此被前沿模型如GLM-5.2(GLM-5 Team,2026)和Kimi-K3(Kimi Team,2026)所采用. 尽管MOE架构的普及程度不断提高,但大多数现有的参数效率微调(PEFT)方法(Hu等人,2022年;Houlsby等人,2019年;Li和Liang,2021年)和配方最初都是为密集模型设计的,社区仍然缺乏将PEFT方法应用于MOE结构的系统指南. 鉴于教育部模型通常包含大量参数,必须采用科学依据的准则,将PEFT应用于这些模型,以实现有效的适应。 因此,这一差距提出了一个紧迫的问题: 如何调整教育部模式,实现最佳性能-效率平衡,同时尽量减少遗忘?

blocks.en: To answer this question, we conduct a large-scale systematic empirical study using representative MoE backbones from different families, including Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) , Gemma-4-26B-A4B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , and GPT-OSS-20B ( OpenAI, 2025 ) . Specifically, we structure our study around four main axes: (1) which modules should be targeted for adapting MoE models under a similar trainable parameter budget? (2) should adaptation granularity for MoE modules be set at the module level, expert level, or weight level? (3) which PEFT method generally works best for adapting MoE models? (4) how strong should the auxiliary loss coefficient be set for adapting MoE models? We conduct the study using two distinct downstream tasks and two general tasks. The first downstream task is mathematical reasoning, on which base models typically already possess strong capabilities; it serves to probe whether further leverages well-established knowledge. The second downstream task is an intent classification task, which yields unsatisfactory results for the three base models and therefore provides a more stringent test of a PEFT method’s ability to adapt in under-represented regimes.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们利用来自不同家庭的具有代表性的MOE骨干进行了大规模的系统的经验性研究,包括Qune3-30B-A3B-Base(Quen Team,2025年),Gemma-4-26B-A4B(Gemma Team,2026年),以及GPT-OSS-20B(OpenAI,2025年). 具体地说,我们的研究围绕四个主要轴线:(1) 哪些模块应当用于在类似的可培训参数预算下调整教育部模型? (2) 是否应将教育部模块的适应颗粒性设定在模块一级、专家一级或重量一级? (3)哪一种PEFT方法一般最能适应MOE模型? (4) 为调整教育部模型应确定多大的辅助损失系数? 我们利用两项不同的下游任务和两项一般任务进行研究。 第一个下游的任务是数学推理,基础模型通常已经具备强大的能力;它有助于探究进一步利用成熟的知识。 第二个下游任务是意向分类任务,它给三个基本模型带来不令人满意的结果,因此对PEFT方法在任职人数不足的制度中进行调整的能力提供了更严格的检验。

blocks.en:
Our study therefore yields four instructive insights: (1) applying adaptation solely to experts, achieves the best downstream performance; (2) within the MoE modules, applying adaptation at the weight level is more reliable than at the expert level or module level; (3) among the evaluated PEFT methods, LoRA and DoRA deliver the strongest downstream performance, whereas methods with weaker general capabilities retention can fail to learn the target task properly; (4) auxiliary load balancing may degrade performance on both downstream tasks and general capabilities retention. Guided by these findings, we revisit MoE 2 -LoRA, a PEFT method tailred for MoE fine-tuning, which established a learned mapping between the selection of pre-trained MoE experts and that of LoRA experts.
Our modification on MoE 2 -LoRA improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters and only a 3.2-point average downstream cost, turning a large task-dependent forgetting into near-complete retention and thereby showing that our insights are effective beyond the controlled grid.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们的研究产生了四个启发性见解:(1) 仅对专家适用适应措施,取得最佳下游业绩;(2) 在教育部模块中,在重量一级适用适应措施比在专家一级或模块一级更可靠;(3) 在评估的PEFT方法中,LORA和DORA提供最强的下游业绩,而一般能力保留较弱的方法可能无法正确学习目标任务;(4) 辅助负荷平衡可能会降低下游任务和一般能力保留方面的业绩。 以这些调查结果为指导,我们重新审视了教育部2-LORA,一种PEFT方法尾随于教育部微调,该方法在预训的教育部专家与LORA专家的甄选之间建立了借鉴的图谱。
我们对MOE 2-LORA的修改将所有四个上游端点都提高了2.4至17.9点,减少了17%的可训练参数,只有3.2点的平均下游成本,将一个大型的任务依赖性忘却变成了近乎完整的保留,从而表明我们的洞察力在控制网格之外是有效的.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • To our knowledge, this is the first large-scale PEFT study conducted directly on pretrained MoE LLMs, covering four design axes, three heterogeneous backbones, and two downstream tasks. Beyond the downstream accuracy that PEFT work usually reports alone, we pair every selected checkpoint with general-capability evaluation on MMLU-Pro and IFEval, so each design choice is judged by what it gains and by what it costs the pretrained model. • We distill the study into four actionable insights on adaptation position, expert granularity, update form, and load balancing, each stated with the regime in which it holds, providing concrete defaults and open questions for future work on MoE adaptation. Functional and spectral analyses explain how weight-level updates reuse pretrained expert computation. • We show the insights are practical by refining MoE 2 -LoRA, a recent routed-pool method, along the single axis it does not already follow, which improves all four general-capability endpoints with 17% fewer parameters.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 据我们所知,这是第一次直接针对预先训练的MOE LLMs进行大规模PEFT研究,涉及四个设计轴,三个不同的主干,以及两个下游任务. 除了PEFT通常单独报告的下游准确性外,我们还将每个选定的检查站与MMLU-Pro和IFEval的一般能力评价配对,因此,每个设计选择都根据它获得什么以及它花费多少预先训练过的模型来判断。 我们把研究报告提炼成关于适应位置、专家颗粒性、更新形式和载荷平衡的四种可操作的见解,这些见解都与研究报告所遵循的制度一致,为教育部今后的适应工作提供了具体的默认和未决问题。 功能和光谱分析解释重量级如何更新再利用预先训练的专家计算。 我们通过精炼MoE 2-LORA(一种最近的路由集合方法)来显示这些见解是实用的,沿着它还没有遵循的单一轴线,它用17%的参数来改进所有四个一般能力终点。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: PEFT adapts large models by learning a small set of parameters while keeping pretrained weights largely frozen. Low-rank methods modify pretrained weights through compact updates: LoRA learns a low-rank residual, while DoRA decouples weight magnitude and direction to improve the update ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . OFT and FourierFT further restrict the update space through orthogonal transformations and frequency-domain parameterization, respectively ( Qiu et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024b ) , whereas IA3 adapts the model by scaling intermediate activations ( Liu et al., 2022 ) . A complementary line introduces conditional computation into PEFT by organizing prompts, adapters, or LoRA modules as routed experts ( Dou et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024a ; Tian et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) . However, these methods are predominantly validated on dense models. It therefore remains unclear how PEFT should interact with the existing experts and routers of an MoE model. In this paper, we systematically study adaptation position, expert granularity, update form, and load balancing to derive principled guidelines for applying PEFT to MoE models.
blocks.zh: PEFT通过学习一小组参数来适应大型模型,同时保持预先训练的重量基本被冷冻. 低等级方法通过紧凑更新修改预加载重 : LoRA学习了低级残基,而DoRA则脱钩重量级和方向改进更新(Hu等人,2022年;Liu等人,2024年a). OFT和FourierFT分别通过正交转换和频率域参数化进一步限制更新空间(邱等人,2024年;高等人,2024年b),而IA3则通过缩放中间激活来调整模型(刘等人,2022年). 一条补充线通过组织提示、适配器或LORA模块作为路由专家,将有条件的计算引入PEFT(Dou等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年;Gao等人,2024年a); Tian等人, 2024; Roo等人, 2024). 然而,这些方法主要是在密集的模型上验证的. 因此,PEFT应如何与教育部模式的现有专家和路由器互动,这一点仍然不清楚。 在本文中,我们系统地研究适应位置、专家颗粒性、更新形式和负载平衡,以得出将PEFT应用于教育部模型的原则准则。

blocks.en: PEFT for pretrained MoE models is not a straightforward extension of dense-model PEFT, because sparse routing governs how limited trainable parameters receive supervision. Since each token is dispatched to a few experts, PEFT modules receive uneven, task-dependent signals, making expert selection and update sharing central design choices ( Wang et al., 2024c ) . Conventional top- k k routing also provides incomplete gradients for PEFT modules optimization during post-training ( Yao et al., ) . Moreover, load-balancing objectives may enforce overly uniform routing and weaken the specialization induced by expert-specific updates on narrow downstream distributions ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . Existing PEFT studies address parts of this through task-relevant expert selection, expert-wise allocation, joint router–expert adaptation, or additional routed adaptation modules ( Wang et al., 2024c ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . However, they often vary simultaneously in adaptation position, expert granularity, update form, routing strategy, and balancing objective, making it difficult to determine which choices consistently benefit. We therefore conduct a controlled study of these factors to derive robust principles for MoE adaptation.
blocks.zh: 用于预先培训的MOE模型的PEFT并不是密集型PEFT的直截了当的延伸,因为有限的可培训参数如何受到监管的路径很少。 由于每个令牌都发送给少数专家,PEFT模块接收到不均匀,任务依赖的信号,使得专家选择和更新共享中央设计选择(Wang等人,2024c). 常规顶-k k 路由也为PEFT模块在培训后优化提供了不完整的梯度(姚等人, .)。 此外,负载平衡目标可能执行过于统一的路由,并削弱专家对狭窄的下游分布进行更新所产生的专业化(Wang等人,2024a); 郭等, 2025 (中文(简体) ). 现有的PEFT研究通过与任务有关的专家甄选、专家分配、联合路由器-专家适应或附加路由适应模块(Wang等人,2024c); Bai等人,2025年;Deng等人,2026年;Liu等人,2024b;Yang等人,2026年). 然而,它们往往在适应位置、专家颗粒性、更新形式、路线战略和平衡目标方面同时不同,因此难以确定哪些选择始终受益。 因此,我们对这些因素进行了有控制的研究,以便为教育部的适应工作提出强有力的原则。

blocks.en: We evaluate Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, Gemma-4-26B-A4B, and GPT-OSS-20B on two complementary downstream tasks, specifically mathematical reasoning and intent classification. Appendix E details their architectures. For the intent classification task, the models are trained on ESFT_Intent ( Wang et al., 2024c ) and evaluated by exact match on 500 held-out examples. For the mathematical reasoning task, models are trained on MetaMathQA-R1, derived from MetaMathQA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , and evaluated on MATH-500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) .

blocks.en:
We use MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024b ) and IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) to measure the general capabilities, including knowledge-based reasoning and instruction-following retained after downstream adaptation. For each configuration and model–task pair in the four design studies, we train three seeds per candidate learning rate and select the rate with the highest mean downstream score.
We evaluate the three checkpoints at that rate on MMLU-Pro and IFEval and report three-seed means, without using general scores for selection. Detailed implementation settings are provided in Appendix B . Selected learning rates and Qwen3 training throughput are reported in Appendix H .

blocks.en: 4.1 Which Modules Should be Targeted for Adaptation?

blocks.en: We compare attention-only ( r = 64 r=64 ), expert-only ( r = 256 r=256 ), and attention+experts ( r = 32 r=32 and 128 128 ) under a comparable budget, using one shared branch for the expert block to keep the focus on position. We repeat each with a rank-8 router update and also test the higher-budget attention/expert pair ( r = 64 / 256 r=64/256 ), with and without router adaptation.

blocks.en: 5 Design Implications
blocks.zh: 5 设计影响

blocks.en:
To test whether the insights transfer to a composite method, we refine MoE 2 -LoRA ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . It follows Insight 1 by adapting only MoE modules with frozen attention and follows Insight 4 by disabling auxiliary load balancing. It also uses the native router to select entries from a shared pool without updating router weights. Its remaining mismatch is Insight 2: the pool is a module-level bypass rather than an update to native expert projections. We therefore replace each of the 128 rank-32 pool entries with a low-rank update to native expert weights while retaining the routed pool, router-driven selection, frozen attention, and zero balancing coefficient.
Appendix A.1 gives both update equations.

为了检验洞察力是否转移到综合方法,我们改进了MOE 2-LORA(Yang等人,2026年)。 它跟随"Insight 1",通过仅调整有冷冻注意力的MOE模块,并通过使辅助负载平衡失效来跟随"Insight 4". 它还使用本土路由器从共享池中选择条目,而不更新路由器的权重. 它剩下的不匹配是Insight 2:游泳池是一个模块级的绕道,而不是本土专家预测的更新. 因此,我们用低级更新本地专家权重替换128个排名32的池子条目,同时保留路由池,路由器驱动选择,冷冻注意,零平衡系数.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
MoE-PEFT is not only a choice of update parameterization; placement, granularity, optimization, and routing objectives materially change its reliability. Across three backbones and two tasks, expert FFNs are the downstream-robust placement, native expert weights are the most reliable evaluated granularity, LoRA/DoRA lead when a high downstream floor is enforced, and zero auxiliary load balancing is the only no-tuning joint default. None is universal: mixed placement can drift less, low-drift update forms can adapt poorly, and a moderate auxiliary coefficient can trade downstream accuracy for better retention of some general capabilities. Our Qwen3 analyses show that weight-level adaptation combines broad functional responses with strong reuse of pretrained spectral structure.
These defaults also carry over beyond our own grid: a weight-level redesign of MoE 2 -LoRA that moves its module-level bypass pool into native expert weights improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters at a small downstream cost. We therefore offer these defaults as a scoped but directionally reliable starting point for MoE adaptation.
We hope our findings and analyses can stimulate further research on parameter-efficient adaptation of MoE models, and encourage future methods to report what each design choice costs the pretrained model alongside what it gains.

MOE-PEFT不仅是更新参数化的选择;布置,颗粒性,优化,以及路由目标在实质上改变了它的可靠性. 在三个主干线和两个任务中,专家FFN是下游-robust布置,本土专家权重是最可靠的评价颗粒性,LORA/DORA在高下游层执行时领先,零辅助负载平衡是唯一的不调联默认. 无一是通用的:混合布置可以减少漂移,低驱动更新形式可以不善适应,温和的辅助系数可以交易下游精度,以更好地保留一些一般能力. 我们的Quen3分析显示,重量级的适应结合了广泛的功能反应和对预先训练的光谱结构的强烈再利用.
这些默认也超越了我们自己的网格:对MOE 2-LORA进行重量级重新设计,将模块级绕行池移到本地专家权重中,将所有四个上游端点都提高了2.4至17.9点,以较低的下游成本减少了17%的可训练参数. 因此,我们提出这些缺省作为教育部适应的一个范围大但方向可靠的起点。
我们希望我们的调查结果和分析能够刺激对教育部模型参数效率调整的进一步研究,并鼓励今后的方法报告每个设计选择的成本以及其收益。

blocks.en: The mathematical-reasoning experiments fine-tune on MetaMathQA-R1 (huggingface oumi-ai/MetaMathQA-R1 ), a pre-constructed synthetic dataset whose problems are drawn from MetaMathQA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and whose responses are generated by DeepSeek-R1. We use only the final solution portion of each response for training, excluding the intermediate think content. Mathematical reasoning is evaluated on the 500 examples in MATH-500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) . The intent experiments fine-tune on ESFT_Intent and report exact-match accuracy on a held-out set of 500 examples. We assess general-capability retention on MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024b ) and IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) .

blocks.en: D.2 Evidence for the Two Design Defaults
blocks.zh: D.2 两种设计默认的证据

blocks.en:
Starting from the experts-only reference, adding attention adaptation at an
effectively matched parameter budget consistently weakens downstream
performance: Intent decreases from 84.00 to 81.60 and MATH-500 from 60.00 to
56.60. For each task, the joint Attention+experts configuration also
degrades at least one upstream benchmark. On Intent, IFEval falls from 18.11 to 14.23
despite the MMLU-Pro improvement; on Math, MMLU-Pro falls from 48.19 to 47.56
despite the IFEval improvement. Adding attention therefore fails to provide a
consistent benefit and instead introduces simultaneous downstream and upstream
degradation on both tasks. These results reinforce Insight 1: for MoE
fine-tuning, target the experts by default and unfreeze shared attention
modules cautiously, since adapting more modules does not necessarily yield
better transfer and may amplify general-capability forgetting.
